about_the_game:
Once upon a time, a gashapon machine spit out a different capsule, a ball that jumped into this playground in the sky!

Control your gashan ball through different platforms in 60 seconds, collect your coins and reach the checkpoint!

Are you ready to face low gravity, spikes and much more in this playground in the sky?

Game elements:

  • Challenging platforms;

  • Cheerful and engaging soundtrack;

  • New skins released;

  • Guaranteed fun for the whole family!
